gaps.explanation: Printed rounding in the report itself, not a missing or duplicate line. p6 proprietary statement: the Total column lines (Personal services 191,593, Utilities 56,153, Insurance 10,048, Repairs and maintenance 58,366, Supplies 23,804, Other services and charges 29,815, Depreciation and amortization 62,694) + Interest expense 6,170 = 438,643 (statement total). The detail lines are the Water / Sewer / Golf fund-column cells exactly as printed: Water 147,998 + interest 6,170, Sewer 162,325, Golf 122,146 = 438,639. On four rows the printed fund cells add to 1 less than the printed Total cell: Personal services 75,517 + 75,467 + 40,608 = 191,592 (Total 191,593); Utilities 23,408 + 6,287 + 26,457 = 56,152 (56,153); Supplies 8,873 + 6,821 + 8,109 = 23,803 (23,804); Other services and charges 4,762 + 1,918 + 23,134 = 29,814 (29,815). 4 x 1 = 4 = gap. The printed fund totals (147,999 / 162,326 / 122,148) also differ from their own lines by 1/1/2 (rounding, already in report_discrepancies). Nothing to add or remove; printed cells stay as printed.
